Simple Banana Loaf
Yield: 1 loaf, 16 slices
Ingredients
2 cups (454g) thoroughly mashed banana, about 4 or 5 medium bananas
1/2 cup (99g) vegetable oil
1 cup (200g) brown sugar, packed
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup (120g) unbleached all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking soda
3/4 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup (57g) chopped walnuts, toasted if desired; optional*
Instructions
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9" x 5" loaf pan.
Mix everything together and bake for 60 to 75 minutes.
